nonblocking_findings: F26 [Nit] phase-acceptance: blog-posts-loader.adversarial.test.ts:75–85 uses a fixed directory under /home/daniebo. A3, A4, A6, and A7 do not apply. The exact phase diff changes no Measure contract test, framework filter, or track registry.
Fresh heavy-run coverage passed all 1,412 tests in 98 files with no skipped test. It reports 92.07% lines (1,674 of 1,818), above the 85.52% floor.
Fresh heavy-run type checking completed with no diagnostics. Lint reported zero errors and three existing warnings. V8 still reports the existing Markdown remap warnings.

F25 withdrawn: proof-f25.log and the real-filesystem loader tests confirm that a symlink to a regular file is parsed. The paired in-memory probe gave both suites the same symlink entry and blank author. Both exited 1 and named the entry.
ADV-22 closed: proof-adv22.log names the directory symlink in both discovery cases. The fresh paired probes exercise a symlink to a directory and a direct directory, each with a lowercase .md name.
Both directory inputs fail at the phase base with EISDIR. At the audited HEAD, both discovery cases fail and name the input. The two forms cannot pass by omission.
The uppercase .MD symlink to a directory is an extra check, not a loss. The phase base ignores that suffix. The merged suite names the input and exits 1.
ADV-23 stays a note. Both suites exclude a locale-level directory symlink through the same Dirent.isDirectory() test. ADV-24 stays a note because hard links are regular files to both suites.
The merged suite retains 15 rules and two discovery cases. proof-blog-merge.log names a broken regular post. A fresh blank-author probe also exits 1 and names en/1-district-1-quality-school.
The approved merge counts under classification.md:250–255. It preserves the K row and fails by post name. The baseline of 3,175 cases falls to 1,412, a reduction of 1,763 cases or 55.53%.
F1, F2, and F3 still hold. Fresh probes exit 1 for a duplicate contact number, visible GSE copy in the B2C section, and a cancelled Tutor Advantage package.
F22, F23, and F24 still hold. Fresh probes exit 1 for a dot-prefixed post, a pricing color override, and a changed hero gradient stop.
The focused run passes 91 tests in 11 files. It includes the F1–F3 and F22–F25 checks and the loader and contrast probes.

The phase diff and commit path inventory contain only www tests, test fixtures, and plan.md. No production file, blog post, or tutor-commission test changed. The Phase 4 pilot report remains out of scope.
